verdict.rationale: Meltano is documented as a CLI-first tool covering the whole lifecycle a coding agent would drive headlessly. It scaffolds with `meltano init`, adds plugins with an idempotent `meltano add`, inspects and tests config with `meltano config list` and `config test`, and executes pipelines with `meltano run`. Project state lives in a version-controllable YAML file, and community evidence corroborates the CLI-first design. missing for 10: no HTTP API (OpenAPI probes all 404), no explicit evidence of setting config values non-interactively (e.g. `meltano config set` or env-var injection), no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, no hands-on evidence of an agent actually driving it end to end.
